data.name: Flipto
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Veblen Finance LLC

Utilise cutting edge CrockChain technology to generate a fortune in FliptoCurrency!**

Spin, Nudge and Strike to mine coins. Upgrade your rig to mine even more!

**all fortunes generated remain the property of Veblen Finance LLC

Meet the Coins

Byte Coin - The OG.

It's as stable as FliptoCurrencies get, but less swings means less opportunities.

Light Coin - The New Hotness.

It can do anything Byte Coin can do, not quite as well but with much more pizzazz!

Mysterium - The Enigma.

What secrets lie behind that deep, dark eye? He'll never tell...

Doggo Coin - The Meme

Dogs are great! Pictures of dogs are great! Digital representation of pictures of dogs are definitely a sound investment!

Features

Flipto is a rogue-like slot-machine-builder, where you can customise every aspect of your run.

  • 13 starting loadouts that alter the way runs play out.

  • 10 available roles from Intern to CEO, each more difficult than the last.

  • 200 tokens that grant a wide range of static effects.

  • Over 150 mods to apply to the slots on your rig

  • Upgrades to the number of actions and inventory slots available to you that last the whole run, as well as extra unlockable lines to score on.

**Disclaimer: no real blockchain technology was involved in the making of this game. Honestly, I don't really even understand how that stuff works

data.short_description: A rogue-like slot-machine builder that pokes fun at cryptocurrency and capitalism. Score lines and set off chain reactions to generate a fortune. Reinvest that fortune to amass an even bigger one! All the fun of day-trading in a casino, but without the risk of financial ruin!

*languages with full audio support
